The safe in the room was a joke, wouldn't latch no matter what I tried. Breakfast the next morning was a letdown, eggs and pastries gone by 8:30 and never refilled. On the plus side, the hotel's right in the thick of downtown, walking distance to everything the city had to offer.

title: Disappointing F1 Weekend Stay
text: Went to Austin for the Grand Prix with my mates, booked the Wrenfield because it was central to the action. The location was actually perfect, right in the thick of it all. But the noise was a nightmare; road crews were working on the interstate outside literally all night during race weekend, impossible to sleep even with earplugs in. Also, tried to grab something at the breakfast buffet at 8:30am and they were completely out of eggs and pastries, nothing got restocked after that. Felt pretty rough starting the race days hungry and exhausted. Location's the only thing going for it really.

title: Great stay before sets
text: Me and the crew rolled into town for the fest. The vibe was killer. Had a solid session at the good gym before heading out. Overall a decent spot to crash between shows.

title: Perfect pit stop lodging
text: arrived friday morning after a long drive from dallas, mainly to soak in the atmosphere leading up to saturdays big race. the room was spotless from the moment i walked in, everything felt fresh and tidy without any fuss. spent the afternoon checking out some local spots on 6th street before heading back to unwind. the girlfriend was happy with the space, and we both crashed early to be ready for the energy of the weekend. the quiet ambiance made it easy to rest up for the action ahead.

title: Mixed feelings about the stay
text: Stayed at Hotel Wrenfield for the F1 race weekend with a friend. It was great being so central, walking distance to all the action downtown. Unfortunately the breakfast was disappointing - by 8:30am the buffet was completely empty of eggs and pastries and nothing got refilled. Also the AC in the room was pretty weak, struggled to keep cool. The location really saved it though, made getting to the circuit easy.

title: Race Weekend Stay
text: stayed at the hotel during the F1 race weekend in austin with my brother. we were both huge fans of the event and spent friday and saturday at the circuit soaking up the atmosphere. friday night we grabbed burgers downtown before heading back to the room. the room itself was decent, spacious enough for us to unpack and relax. the highlight of the stay was definitely the overall cleanliness. the rooms and common areas looked spotless and well-maintained, which was a nice change of pace after long days at the track. unfortunately, the breakfast experience was a bit of a letdown. we tried to grab some coffee and something to eat before heading out, but the coffee urns were completely empty and there were no clean mugs or plates available. it felt a bit unprofessional to start the day that way. despite that hiccup, we had a great time overall and would probably stay again, just maybe skip the morning rush next time.

title: Conference Trip
text: Stayed in town for a tech conference. Valet parking cost $55 a night, felt steep for downtown rates. Hotel was very clean and the staff were friendly. Travelled alone, spent the day at sessions.

title: Weekend Trip to Austin
text: The hubby and I were in town for a music festival, so we needed a spot to crash after late night sets. Honestly, the quick check-in was a lifesaver, and the room was super clean, which we really appreciated. The only downsides were the nonstop road crew noise from the interstate outside – seriously, impossible to sleep even with earplugs in. Also, we had to ask twice for fresh towels before they finally brought some. Other than that, it was a decent spot for the weekend.

title: A Bittersweet Stay
text: Attending the Austin City Limits fest this year, us three friends chose Hotel Wrenfield for the convenience. Honestly, the staff were warm and helpful from the moment we walked in. The spot is great central location-wise, putting us within walking distance of the stages. On the flip side, the AC in our room was pretty weak, struggled to keep us cool at night. Also, found a hair in the shower drain, which was a bit grim. Decent enough for a music trip, but those two things dragged the experience down a little.

title: Average Stay for Austin Tech Meet
text: attended the tech meetup downtown and needed a place to crash for the night. chose this place because it was close to the venue, but the room itself felt pretty small for the price point. had to pay a premium for a basic setup, which felt a bit off given the square footage. checked in late, front desk was efficient enough, but didn't really stand out either way. spent the day wandering around the city, hitting a few food trucks and checking out the live music scene. the room was functional, bed was okay, but nothing exceptional. would probably look at other options next time if the budget allows, just because the cost-to-space ratio didn't quite hit the mark for what i expected. overall, it was fine for a single night, just not something i'd rave about to friends.

title: Billing Mix-up Marshals Trip
text: checked into Hotel Wrenfield after a long day of client meetings downtown. the purpose of the trip was a series of back-to-back presentations, and i was sharing the room with a colleague from the austin office. we spent the afternoon reviewing contract details at a nearby coffee shop before returning to the hotel. the room itself was impeccable spotless, everything arranged neatly, which was a relief after a tiring schedule. however the stay was marred by a frustrating billing mistake at check-out. the front desk initially quoted one rate, but the final charge on my card was significantly higher, requiring a lengthy phone call to the accounting department to resolve. it felt like an unnecessary administrative hurdle in the middle of an otherwise professional trip. despite the clean environment, the financial discrepancy left a sour note and i left feeling that the hotel's billing processes needed tightening up before my next visit.

title: weekend escape
text: stayed here with my partner to check out the live music scene. found a great spot nearby, relaxed in the room, and headed out for dinner. nice stay, would come back.

title: Weekend noise trouble
text: f1 fan here. downtown austin for the race weekend. drove in friday morning. quick check-in got me settled fast. comfy bed helped after the long drive. rooftop bar was great for watching the action. but the overnight construction was awful. jackhammers and trucks from midnight to 5am on the freeway side ruined any sleep. tried to relax but the noise was constant....MoreDear Aisha, Thank you for sharing your stay experience.
